name: Isle Mystique
source:
Hero became an owner of the island in the vicinity of Okinawa. There was a famous statue of dragon there. But one day it was revealed that the standing statue was a fake. Now it's needed to find the real one sold by pieced around the island.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
